attchmntText: SJVN Limited has informed the Exchange regarding a press release dated November 23, 2026, titled "Hon ble Prime Ministers of India and Nepal Jointly LayFoundation Stone of SJVN s 669 MW Lower Arun Hydro Electric Project".
voiceSummary: SJVN Limited filed a press release regarding the foundation stone laying for its 669 MW Lower Arun Hydro Electric Project in Nepal. The project, developed by wholly owned subsidiary SJVN Lower Arun Power Development Company Pvt. Ltd., has an estimated cost of Rs. 5,792.36 crore. The tentative tariff is Rs. 4.99 per unit, with annual energy generation of approximately 2,901 million units. The project integrates with the 900 MW Arun-3 Hydro Electric Project for tandem operation. It comprises four generating units of 167.25 MW each. Construction is underway under a Build, Own, Operate and Transfer basis. Commissioning is targeted for financial year 2030-31. The Government of Nepal awarded the project on 29th January 2021.

attchmntText: SJVN Limited has informed the Exchange regarding 'SJVN achieves Commercial Operation of 45 MW out of 50 MW Sonitpur Solar Power Project in Assam'.
voiceSummary: SJVN Limited announces that its wholly owned subsidiary, SJVN Green Energy Limited, has achieved commercial operation for 45 MW out of the 50 MW Sonitpur Solar Power Project in Assam. The project is located in the Sonitpur District. SJVN Green Energy Limited signed a Power Purchase Agreement with Assam Power Distribution Company Limited on 07.02.2024 for the supply of 50 MW of solar power. Power from the project is supplied to Assam Power Distribution Company Limited under this agreement. The Trial Run Certificate was issued by Assam Power Distribution Company Limited via letter dated 21.11.2026. The project achieved commercial operation on 21.11.2026.

attchmntText: SJVN Limited has informed the Exchange regarding a press release dated November 21, 2026, titled "Prime Minister Shri Narendra Modi Dedicated Second Unit of SJVN's 1320 MW Buxar Thermal Power Project in Bihar to the Nation".
voiceSummary: SJVN Limited filed a press release stating that Prime Minister Narendra Modi virtually dedicated the Second Unit of the company's 1320 MW Buxar Thermal Power Project in Bihar to the nation. The Second Unit has a capacity of 660 MW and involved an investment of Rs. 7,221.09 crore. The project is developed by SJVN Thermal Private Limited, a wholly-owned subsidiary. With this unit, the project has achieved its full capacity of 1320 MW. The total approved revised cost of the project is Rs. 14,269.40 crores. The project is expected to generate approximately 9,828.72 million units of energy annually. Eighty-five percent of the power generated has been allocated to Bihar under a long-term Power Purchase Agreement. The project utilizes Ultra Super Critical Technology and has a Fuel Supply Agreement with Central Coalfields Limited.
